method: Microsoft GW-BASIC under FreeDOS/QEMU; real keyboard input and BIOS text-screen capture; console I/O unchanged

cases.source:
10 CLS
20 LOCATE 5,7:PRINT "PRE";
30 INPUT "Q";S$
40 R=CSRLIN:C=POS(0)
50 PRINT TAB(20);"T";:PRINT ,"Z";
60 R2=CSRLIN:C2=POS(0)
70 OPEN "O00.TXT" FOR OUTPUT AS #1
80 PRINT #1,R;C;R2;C2:PRINT #1,S$
90 CLOSE #1:LOCATE 18,1:PRINT "DONE00":END
